chunks.text: Call us on 087-348 3560 or email us at brakethrusom@gmail.com to book a lesson.
For driving lessons in the Dundalk area, Brake-Thru School of Motoring is your No.1 choice.

Covering all aspects of driving, from beginners to the more expierienced driver, we'll get you ready to pass your driving test first time. Why not buy a gift voucher for a loved one and get them on the right road to getting their driving licence. For more information, call Aidan on 087-348 3560 . If your a nervous driver then your in the right place. Book a lesson now with a friendly, patient and profesional Driving Instructor in a dual control car. If you prefer to complete lessons in your own car then that's not a problem.

Give a gift voucher from “Dundalk's Best Driving School”. It’s a present that they will never forget.

Gift vouchers make an excellent present for anybody, whether its a young person eager to get on the road or perhaps a late starter ready to learn to drive. Here at Brake-Thru School of Motoring we tailor each lesson to the learner, helping to make it stress-free and an enjoyable experience. Vouchers are available for single or multiple lessons, and they will be a FABULOUS present to receive. Contact Aidan on 087-348 3560 or click the button below for more info.

"I had a great experience doing lessons with you. I think you're a great instructor, always worked around hours to suit me, very punctual and good with explaining everything. I didn't have a clue how to drive a car when I started and after 15 lessons I was ready for the test! All thanks to you." Zaneta
"Lovely teacher! Really patient, made me feel so comfortable and confident while driving! Passed my test first time, I would recommend this school to anyone." Kerri

"It was a pleasure to do driving lessons with Aidan. He made me feel comfortable and at ease at all times, whilst giving me constructive criticism. Aidan ensured that I was familiar with all the roads in Dundalk before my test, and I couldn’t have done it without him. I would highly recommend Aidan!" Ella

"Thank you so much Aidan for accommodating us at such short notice to get Oisín over the line. We really appreciate the lengths you were willing to go to to timetable him at the 11th hour. You positioned him perfectly to do his best drive ever and he managed to pass without a single mark against him. We’re delighted and we wish you the very best in your new venture." Martin and Sile

At Brake-Thru School of Motoring, we understand the issues facing learner drivers. That's why we make learning to drive an enjoyable experience, with qualified driving instructors who'll guide you through each step of your journey. We want to take the stress out of learning to drive.
